subject: A time series behind each mention
body:
Each account comes back with the articles behind it: totals, first and latest mention, the last thirty days against the thirty before, and the recent pieces with the relation type that produced them.

One account, Brex, reads 66 articles across 31 publications with mentions moving from 17 to 27 between windows. That is a signal with provenance behind it.

I can pull it for a handful of accounts you already track, so you can compare against what your signals return for the same names.
